starter_files.contents:
# Restaurant Menu Website

Practise stylesheet organization while creating a restaurant menu.

## Required behavior
- [ ] Menu categories
- [ ] Reusable menu item styles
- [ ] Color and spacing tokens
- [ ] Responsive menu layout
- [ ] Hover and focus states

Compile Sass to CSS with the project-local Dart Sass CLI. Keep SCSS source, generated CSS, and notes separate. Do not claim production readiness without a browser, accessibility, and CSS-output review.

stretch_features: Add a repeatable compilation and output-check script.
Test keyboard focus and narrow/wide viewports in an actual browser.
Document supported Sass versions, public APIs, and migration notes.

tests.name: Compilation and output
criteria: Every required entrypoint compiles with the documented Dart Sass version.
The generated CSS contains the expected selectors, declarations, and at-rules.

tests.name: Responsive behavior and accessibility
criteria: Rendered UI is checked at representative viewport widths.
Keyboard focus is visible and theme/state information is not communicated by color alone.

tests.name: Maintainability and documentation
criteria: Source modules and public members are clearly named.
Build steps, assumptions, output-size changes, and limitations are documented.

rubric.criterion: Build validation, CSS output review, and tests

status_note: Project brief is based on Section D of the supplied Sass.pdf; starter scaffolding and assessment rubric are original CodeLeaf authoring. Human review is required.
